concerns.text: Task T022 ('Property Range Extrapolation' and 'New Element' checks) is marked as missing/rejected in the analyze report. This task is the sole implementation of FR-010 (validate no 'new element' in test fold) and Plan Methodology 3 (convex hull check). Without T022, the LOSO cross-validation integrity defined in FR-003 cannot be maintained, and the pipeline cannot satisfy the spec's requirement to skip folds with new elements.

Task T024 (Null model baseline and comparison) is marked as missing. This is the only task addressing FR-009 (compare RF against null baseline) and SC-008 (statistically significant improvement). The absence of this task means the core research hypothesis validation (non-triviality of ML model) cannot be executed.

Task T025 (Permutation Test) is marked as missing. This task is required to satisfy SC-008's requirement for a p-value < 0.05 using a permutation test on fold-level MAE differences. Without T025, the statistical significance claim in the spec cannot be verified.

Task T028 (Resource monitoring) is marked as missing. This task implements FR-006 (single CPU execution) and SC-003 (4-hour/7GB limit) enforcement. Without T028, the pipeline cannot automatically halt if resource constraints are violated, violating the Constitution Principle VI.

All visualization tasks (T032-T038) are marked as missing. These tasks are required to implement FR-005 (generate visualization plots) and SC-004 (visual fidelity MAE ≤ 50K). The absence of these tasks means the domain expert cannot qualitatively assess the model's ability to reconstruct phase fields as required by US-3.

Foundational tasks T001 (Initialize Project Structure) and T003 (Configure Linting) are marked as missing/rejected. The plan explicitly states 'No user story work can begin until this phase is complete'. Without these, the project structure and code quality standards are undefined, blocking all downstream implementation.

Task T014 (Filtering logic for missing temperature values) is marked as missing. This task implements the edge case handling for ternary systems lacking coordinates (FR-001, Edge Cases). Without T014, the pipeline may crash or include invalid data, violating data quality requirements.

Task T018 (Write processed data to descriptors.csv) is marked as missing. This is the critical output of US-1 required to feed US-2 (T021 depends on T018). Without T018, the data pipeline is incomplete and downstream modeling cannot proceed.

Task T029 (Save trained model artifact) is marked as missing. This task is required for FR-005 (visualization depends on model artifact) and Constitution Principle V (versioning). Without T029, the model cannot be visualized or versioned.

Test tasks T030 (test_tcs_calculation) and T031 (test_plot_generation) are marked as missing. These are mandatory per SC-004 and US-3 independent test requirements. Without them, the visualization logic cannot be verified.

Review resolution tasks T045-T050 are marked as missing. These tasks address specific reviewer concerns regarding data source verification, streaming, and error handling robustness. Their absence leaves known critical gaps in the implementation plan unaddressed.
